q: She said, "What a great achievement!" (Make it indirect Speech)
o: She said that What it was a very great achievement.

q: The teacher said to the student, “Do not waste time.” Its indirect form is:
o: The teacher told the student do not waste time
The teacher prohibited the students not to waste time
The teacher advised the student not to waste time
The teacher advised the student not to wasting time
e: “Do not ...” নিষেধ বা উপদেশ। Indirect-এ তা advised/forbade/told + object + not to + verb আকারে আসে। এখানে advised বেশি স্বাভাবিক: advised the student not to waste time। Prohibited-এর সাথে আবার not বললে দ্বিগুণ নেতিবাচক হয়। ‘not to wasting’ ভুল, কারণ to-এর পরে verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে। আর প্রথম অপশনে to-infinitive নেই।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech. Father said to me, "Where were you'?"
o: Father asked me where I had been.
Father asked me where I went.
Father said to me where was I?
Father asked me where I was.
e: Direct speech-এর প্রশ্নটি past simple-এ (were) আছে এবং reporting verb said past tense, তাই indirect-এ তা past perfect (had been) হবে। Wh-question থেকে indirect করতে said to বদলে asked হয়, wh-word (where) সংযোজক হিসেবে থাকে এবং প্রশ্নের গঠন বদলে assertive ক্রম (subject + verb) হয়। you বদলে object-এর সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে I হয়েছে। where I went বা where I was-এ tense পিছিয়ে নেওয়া হয়নি, আর said to me where was I প্রশ্নের গঠনই রেখে দিয়েছে, তাই ভুল। নিয়মটি: am/is/are → was/were, was/were → had been, present perfect ও past simple → past perfect।

o: He asked me if I was working that day.
He asked me if I was working today.
He asked to me whether I was working that day.

q: He asked me where I_____ last week.
o: had been
was
would be
have been
e: Indirect speech-এ reporting verb অতীতে (asked) থাকলে reported অংশের Past Indefinite বদলে Past Perfect হয়। মূল প্রশ্ন ছিল 'Where were you last week?', তাই পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে হয় He asked me where I had been। প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য পরোক্ষে নিলে সাধারণ বাক্যের গঠন (subject + verb) নেয়, তাই 'where had I been' নয়, 'where I had been'। was দিলে tense-এর পরিবর্তন হয় না, would be ভবিষ্যৎ বোঝায়, আর have been present perfect বলে asked-এর সঙ্গে মেলে না। কঠোর নিয়মে last week পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে the previous week হয়, যেমন He asked me where I had been the previous week।

q: Mostofa said, "Let the girl say whatever she likes." (Change the narration.)
o: Mostofa said the girl might say whatever she likes.
Mostofa told that the girl might say whatever she likes.
Mostofa said that the girl said whatever she liked.
Mostofa said that the girl might say whatever she liked.
e: Let দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া imperative বাক্যের narration বদলাতে reporting verb-এর পরে that বসে, reported speech-এর subject আসে, তারপর might এবং মূল verb থেকে শেষ পর্যন্ত। কাল অনুযায়ী likes বদলে liked হয়। তাই Mostofa said that the girl might say whatever she liked। অর্থ: মোস্তফা বলল, মেয়েটি যা খুশি বলুক।

q: Change the direct narration to indirect narration: "Please don't go away", she said.
o: She told me to go away.
She said to please her and not go away.
She requested me not to go away.
She begged that I not go away.
e: Please দিয়ে অনুরোধ জানানো imperative বাক্যের narration বদলাতে reporting verb requested হয়, আর don't go বদলে not to go বসে। গঠন: Subject + requested + object + not to + verb। তাই "Please don't go away," she said-এর indirect রূপ She requested me not to go away। told বললে অনুরোধের ভাব থাকে না, আর begged that-এর গঠন এখানে অচল।

q: Select the correct indirect speech of the following sentence: He said to me, "How did you do it?"
o: He enquired of me if I had done it.
He asked me that I had done it.
He asked me if I had done it.
He enquired of me how I had done it.
e: Wh-প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যকে Indirect করলে প্রশ্নবোধক শব্দটিই (how) সংযোগকারী হিসেবে থাকে, তাই সঠিক রূপ He enquired of me how I had done it. Reporting verb said to-কে asked বা enquired of করা হয়, you হয় I, আর reporting verb অতীতে থাকায় past indefinite (did ... do) বদলে past perfect (had done) হয়। বাক্যটি প্রশ্ন থেকে বিবৃতির ক্রমে আসে, তাই subject আগে, verb পরে বসে। if বা whether বসে কেবল yes/no প্রশ্নে, তাই if যুক্ত অপশনগুলো ভুল। that বসে assertive বাক্যে, প্রশ্নে নয়। অন্য উদাহরণ: He said to me, 'Where do you live?' হলে Indirect হবে He asked me where I lived.

o: She asked me whether I would go there.
She asked me would I go there.
She asked me when will I go there.

q: My friend said to me, "May you pass the exam."
o: My friend wished that I might pass the exam.
My friend hoped that I may pass the exam.
My friend prayed me I may pass the exam.
My friend wished me I might pass the exam.
e: May you ... দিয়ে শুরু বাক্য শুভকামনা বা প্রার্থনা বোঝায়। Indirect speech-এ এটির reporting verb হয় wished, এরপর that বসে এবং may বদলে might হয়। reporting verb past হওয়ায় এই পরিবর্তন ঘটে। গঠন: Subject + wished that + আসল বাক্যের subject + might + base verb। তাই সঠিক রূপ My friend wished that I might pass the exam। মনে রাখুন: prayed me বা wished me লেখা শুদ্ধ নয়, আর hoped সাধারণত ভবিষ্যৎ আশার জন্য বসে, শুভকামনার জন্য নয়।

q: Change the given sentence from direct to indirect speech: Sayka said to her sister, "Will you go there?"
o: Sayqa asked her sister if she will go there.
Sayka told her sister if she will go there.
Sayqa asks her sister if she would go there.
Sayka asked her sister if she would go there.
e: Yes/No প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যের indirect করতে reporting verb বদলে ask বা asked বসে, quotation চিহ্নের জায়গায় if বা whether আসে, এবং reported speech স্বাভাবিক বাক্যের ক্রমে লেখা হয়। Reporting verb অতীত হওয়ায় will বদলে would হয়। তাই Sayka asked her sister if she would go there শুদ্ধ। Told ব্যবহার করলে প্রশ্নের ভাব থাকে না।
